title: Protocol for Generating Protoplasts of Trichoderma koningiopsis and Transformation of Plasmid DNA
author: Jin, Alberti

steps.title: Prepare filter paper strips
steps.instruction: Cut 9 mm diameter filter papers into six strips, autoclave them, place the strips onto PDA plates to create PDA‑strip plates, incubate 24 h, then transfer each strip to two PDA plates containing the selection marker.

substeps.instruction: Cut 9 mm filter papers into six strips.
Autoclave the strips.
Transfer strips onto PDA plates to form PDA‑strip plates.
Incubate plates for 24 h.
Transfer each strip to two PDA plates with the selection marker.

steps.title: Prepare PEG transformation media
steps.instruction: Prepare PDA solid medium adjusted to pH 6.2 (enough for two plates to yield ~10⁸ spores mL⁻¹), CM liquid medium for germling production, Protoplast buffer (PB) at pH 7.5, PEG buffer (PEGB) at pH 7.5, and PDA‑strip plates as described.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PDA solid medium, adjust to pH 6.2; enough for two plates (~10⁸ spores mL⁻¹).
Prepare CM liquid medium for germling production.
Prepare Protoplast buffer (PB) and adjust to pH 7.5.
Prepare PEG buffer (PEGB) and adjust to pH 7.5.
Prepare PDA‑strip plates (cut, autoclave, place on PDA).

steps.title: Prepare ATMT media
steps.instruction: Prepare YEPAA solid medium for A. tumefaciens LBA4404 growth, IM liquid and solid medium (adjust pH to 5.8 for this strain), autoclave 0.8 µm pore nitrocellulose filters (Ø 47 mm), and PDA solid medium supplemented with 300 µg mL⁻¹ cefotaxime and the selection marker.

substeps.instruction: Prepare YEPAA solid medium for Agrobacterium growth.
Prepare IM liquid and solid medium; adjust pH to 5.8 for LBA4404.
Autoclave nitrocellulose filters (0.8 µm pore, Ø 47 mm).
Prepare PDA solid medium with 300 µg mL⁻¹ cefotaxime and the selection marker.

steps.title: Prepare electroporation media
steps.instruction: Prepare 1.1 M sorbitol solution (keep ice‑cold), YEPD liquid medium, and PDA selective plates for electroporation of spores.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1.1 M sorbitol solution; store ice‑cold for washing/resuspending spores.
Prepare YEPD liquid medium.
Prepare PDA selective plates.

steps.title: Prepare lipofection media
steps.instruction: Prepare PDA‑strip plates as in Figure 1 and supplement PDA solid medium with hygromycin B at 150 µg mL⁻¹ as the selection marker.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PDA‑strip plates (cut, autoclave, place on PDA).
Prepare PDA solid medium containing hygromycin B 150 µg mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Grow Agrobacterium for ATMT
steps.instruction: Streak A. tumefaciens LBA4404 carrying the vector on YEPAA plates with appropriate antibiotics and incubate 30 °C for 48 h; pick a single colony into 10 mL LB with antibiotics and grow overnight at 30 °C; centrifuge 3,200 × g for 10 min, resuspend pellet in IM medium to OD₆₀₀ 0.1–0.2; incubate 30 °C, 170 rpm until OD₆₀₀ 0.4–0.5; concentrate culture to half volume for use in ATMT (prepare a negative control without acetosyringone).

substeps.instruction: Grow A. tumefaciens LBA4404 on YEPAA plates with antibiotics at 30 °C for 48 h.
Transfer a single colony to 10 mL LB with antibiotics; incubate overnight at 30 °C.
Centrifuge culture at 3,200 × g for 10 min and discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in IM medium to reach OD₆₀₀ 0.1–0.2.
Incubate suspension at 30 °C, 170 rpm until OD₆₀₀ 0.4–0.5.
Concentrate the culture to half its original volume; keep on ice for ATMT.
Prepare a negative control without acetosyringone (AS) to test virulence gene requirement.

steps.title: Prepare mycelial suspension for lipofection
steps.instruction: Inoculate T. koningiopsis from –80 °C stocks into 5 mL PDB in a glass universal tube, incubate 30 °C for 2–3 days; transfer ~0.1 g mycelium into a 2 mL screw‑top tube containing 0.5–1 mm bashing beads; disrupt with a VelociRuptor at 4 m s⁻¹ for 40 s (1 cycle); keep the suspension on ice for immediate lipofection.

substeps.instruction: Grow T. koningiopsis from –80 °C stock in 5 mL PDB at 30 °C for 2–3 days.
Transfer approximately 0.1 g mycelium into a 2 mL screw‑top tube with 0.5–1 mm bashing beads.
Disrupt mycelium using VelociRuptor: 1 cycle, 4 m s⁻¹ for 40 s.
Keep the resulting suspension on ice; use immediately for lipofection.
